description: Seven-panel TEM composite (grayscale) of a low-density Fe-28Mn-8Al-1C austenitic steel tracking cryogenic-rolling (CR) deformation from undeformed to 90% reduction. Every panel carries yellow annotation text and arrows; scale bars are 200nm in (a) and 500nm in (b)-(g). (a) Undeformed: bright grain interiors separated by an arrowed "Grain boundary", with arrowed "Dislocation lines" in the darker grain. (b) CR 30%: dark mottled dislocation substructure with dashed yellow lines outlining a "Taylor lattice". (c) CR 50%: an arrowed "Dislocation wall" bordering parallel lamellae labelled "Deformation twin". (d) CR 70%: arrowed "Dislocation cell" and "Dislocation wall" forming a closed cell substructure. (e) CR 90%: heavily refined dark/light dislocation substructure with a circular-selected-area diffraction (SAED) inset showing continuous rings (randomly oriented nanoscale grains). (f) Dark-field TEM of (e) labelled "Nanocrystalline", with an inset histogram (y-axis "Frequency (%)", x-axis "Grain size (nm)") printed "Average: 58.8 nm". (g) Bright-field image highlighting arrowed "Deformation twin" in the CR 90% sample. Together the panels document the sequence slip bands → Taylor lattice → dislocation walls and twins → dislocation cells → nanocrystalline grains averaging 58.8 nm.

observations.observation: Panel (a) is a bright-field TEM image of the undeformed steel with a 200 nm scale bar, yellow arrow annotations reading 'Grain boundary' and 'Dislocation lines'.
Panel (b), CR 30%, shows a mottled dark dislocation substructure over which dashed yellow lines outline a 'Taylor lattice' formed by intersecting slip bands; 500nm scale bar.
Panel (c), CR 50%, is annotated with 'Dislocation wall' and 'Deformation twin', the latter pointing to fine parallel lamellae; 500nm scale bar.
Panel (d), CR 70%, is annotated with 'Dislocation cell' and 'Dislocation wall', showing a cell-like dislocation arrangement; 500nm scale bar.
Panel (e), CR 90%, contains an inset circular SAED pattern with continuous rings, consistent with randomly oriented nanoscale grains; 500nm scale bar.
Panel (f) is a dark-field TEM image of the CR 90% sample labelled 'Nanocrystalline'; its inset histogram prints 'Average: 58.8 nm' with axes 'Frequency (%)' and 'Grain size (nm)'; 500nm scale bar.
Panel (g) is a bright-field TEM image of the CR 90% sample with yellow arrows labelling a 'Deformation twin'.

The caption identifies the panels as TEM images of the test steel: (a) undeformed, (b) CR 30%, (c) CR 50%, (d) CR 70%, (e) CR 90%, (f) corresponding DF-TEM of (e), and (g) bright-field TEM highlighting deformation twins in the CR 90% sample.
Grain-size analysis from multiple dark-field images using Nano-Measurer software yielded an average grain size of 58.8 nm, matching the histogram value printed in panel (f).
The citing text states that at 30% CR the interaction of slip bands with different orientations gives rise to the Taylor lattice seen in Figure 3b.
The citing text states that at 50% CR slip bands diminish while dislocation walls and deformation twins become increasingly visible (Figure 3c).
The citing text states that at 70% CR larger dislocation cells form as dislocation density increases while the density of twins decreases (Figure 3d).

The citing text states dislocation density escalates to 2.36×10^15 m^-2 at 90% deformation, and reports continuous rings in the SAED pattern of Figure 3e indicating randomly oriented nanoscale grains.
The citing text reports that at 90% CR deformation-twin frequency diminishes while subgrain boundaries form from dislocation tangles (Figure 3e).

subfigures.description: Bright-field TEM of the undeformed steel; yellow arrows label a 'Grain boundary' separating two grains and 'Dislocation lines' within the darker grain; 200nm scale bar.
CR 30% sample: dark mottled dislocation substructure with intersecting dashed yellow lines outlining a 'Taylor lattice'; 500nm scale bar.
CR 50% sample: an arrowed dark 'Dislocation wall' next to a region of fine parallel lamellae labelled 'Deformation twin'; 500nm scale bar.
CR 70% sample: arrowed 'Dislocation cell' and 'Dislocation wall' delineating a cellular dislocation substructure; 500nm scale bar.
CR 90% sample: strongly refined dark/light dislocation substructure (subgrain boundaries) with a circular SAED inset displaying continuous rings; 500nm scale bar.

Dark-field TEM corresponding to (e), labelled 'Nanocrystalline' in yellow, with an inset bar histogram of grain size (x-axis 'Grain size (nm)', y-axis 'Frequency (%)') printed 'Average: 58.8 nm'; 500nm scale bar.
Bright-field TEM of the CR 90% sample with two yellow arrows pointing to a 'Deformation twin'; 500nm scale bar.
